sources.title: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
sources.publisher: MedlinePlus / U.S. National Library of Medicine

claims.paraphrased_claim: Abnormal CBC values can have many causes and do not by themselves establish a diagnosis; history, symptoms and sometimes additional tests are needed.
claims.locator: What do the results mean? / Is there anything else I need to know?

claims.paraphrased_claim: Abnormal red-cell, hemoglobin or hematocrit values can be associated with several conditions, including anemia, but the CBC alone does not specify the cause.
Low or high white-cell counts can occur for multiple reasons, including disease processes or medication effects; the count is not a standalone etiologic diagnosis.
